entities.summary: Augusto César Alves Ferreira da Silva, C.M. is a Portuguese Roman Catholic prelate, who served as bishop of the Diocese of Portalegre-Castelo Branco from 1978 to 2004. He previously served as bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Tete in Mozambique from 1972 to 1976.

entities.summary: Augusto César Alves Ferreira da Silva, C.M. is a Portuguese Roman Catholic prelate, who served as bishop of the Diocese of Portalegre-Castelo Branco from 1978 to 2004. He previously served as bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Tete in Mozambique from 1972 to 1976.
